name: search
description: Find where something is implemented or documented in this workspace. Searches a local index of the code and design docs by meaning and by keywords, and returns ranked passages as source:path:start-end with scope, signature and text - usually enough to answer and cite without opening files. Call it before grep.

query.description: What to find: what the code does, in English, plus identifiers you expect (function, class or file names).

name: status
description: Index version, sources, passage counts and build time.
